title: tp to brainrots
script:
local L = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()
local W = L:NewWindow("Main")
local S = W:NewSection("Main")
local P = game:GetService("Players")
local p = P.LocalPlayer
local f = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots")
local b
for _, v in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
	if v:GetAttribute("OccupiedByUserId") == p.UserId then
		b = v
		break
	end
end
local function c()
	return p.Character or p.CharacterAdded:Wait()
end
local function t(x)
	c():PivotTo(CFrame.new(x))
end
local function m(x)
	if x and x:IsA("Model") then
		c():PivotTo(x:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
	end
end
S:CreateButton("TP to base", function()
	m(b or workspace.Plots.Plot1)
end)
S:CreateButton("Secret Area 1", function()
	t(Vector3.new(0, 1736, 4999))
end)
S:CreateButton("Secret Area 2", function()
	t(Vector3.new(-700, 1736, 4599))
end)
S:CreateButton("Secret Area 3", function()
	t(Vector3.new(684, 1736, 3800))
end)
S:CreateButton("Secret Area 4", function()
	t(Vector3.new(-700, 1736, 3800))
end)
S:CreateButton("Secret Area 5", function()
	t(Vector3.new(684, 1736, 4599))
end)
